name: Sonogi Takeshi
source:
Father of Sonogi Akihiro.
A long-serving Kyoto Prefectural Assembly member.
Originally planned for his son to inherit his local political base, but after Sonogi moved into national politics, he began looking for ways to benefit from it.
A strong political operator, though without lofty ideals. His first wife (Sonogi’s mother) died of illness; he later remarried.

[Translated from [url=https://holicworks.net/24ku/mainchara.html]the official website[/url].]
